title: Flaky: VS Code extension E2E (browser-debugger) times out waiting for pwa-msedge child debug session to attach to Blazor WASM
test_name: VS Code extension E2E (matrix shards, e.g. browser-debugger / workspace-target-proof / edge-cases)
job_name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, browser-debugger)
error_pattern: Failed to apply E2E control revision ...: Error: Timed out after 288488ms waiting for pwa-msedge child session for Blazor WASM root '...'. Last error: <none>. State: {"debugSessions":[{"id":"...","type":"monovsdbg_wasm","name":"Wasm Managed Debugger", ...}]}
analysis: The test 'hits a managed breakpoint for standalone' times out after ~288 seconds waiting for the pwa-msedge child debug session to attach to a Blazor WASM root. This matches the previously identified recurring flaky pattern for this shard (issue #19618, 10 prior occurrences, most recently seen 2026-09-14). The PR under test only modifies interaction service and CLI backchannel code, unrelated to Blazor WASM browser debugging.
